prompt: Our customers want to export invoices to CSV. Add that to the billing page.

assertions.text: Quotes the request and splits it into deliverables before any design or code.
assertions.evidence_quote:
## 1. Request (verbatim)

> Our customers want to export invoices to CSV. Add that to the billing page.

## 2. Deliverables and classes

judge.reason: The intake record quotes the request word for word. It then breaks the request into deliverables: D1 is the CSV export endpoint and D2 is the export control on the billing page. The agent wrote no code or design. The final answer says "I haven't written any code yet," and the only file changed is the intake record.

assertions.text: Inspects the billing files before classifying; classes include frontend-logic and backend-api.
assertions.evidence_quote: | D2 | Export control on the billing page | No billing page or frontend code found (Glob `src/**`, `app/**`: only `server.js`, `invoices.js`, `payments.js`) | frontend-logic (provisional) |

judge.reason: Before writing the intake record, the agent read src/invoices.js and src/server.js and globbed src/** and app/**. It then classified D1 as backend-api and D2 as frontend-logic, and the record cites the files it inspected.

assertions.text: Searches knowledge/INDEX.md, projects/, decisions/ and reports/ for an existing export feature and records NEW/EXTENDS/DUPLICATE with citations.
assertions.evidence_quote: | D1, D2 | projects/, decisions/, tickets/, src/, test/, README.md (Grep for invoice/billing/csv/export) | **DUPLICATE** | `projects/demo/BACKLOG.md:6`: SL-2 "CSV export of invoices from the billing page", IN PROGRESS on branch `feat/csv-export` |

judge.reason: The agent's Grep call covered projects/**, decisions/**, knowledge/** and reports/**. The intake record has a duplicate check table that gives a DUPLICATE verdict with a file:line citation (BACKLOG.md:6). It also states that knowledge/INDEX.md and reports/ were searched and returned no match. All four required locations were searched, and the result was recorded as NEW/EXTENDS/DUPLICATE with citations.

assertions.text: Drafts problem, value and success signal and asks the owner to confirm; does not invent a metric or deadline.
assertions.evidence_quote: - Expected value / success signal: not stated by the owner, so I haven't invented one.

judge.reason: The agent did not invent a metric or deadline, and it drafted a problem statement taken from the PRD. It did not draft the value or the success signal, though: it left both blank. Its open questions also never ask the owner to confirm the problem, value or success signal. They only cover the duplicate, the date range, roles, who the user is and where the UI lives. Only part of the assertion holds, so it fails.

assertions.text: Writes docs/agent-ops/INTAKE_RECORD.md and routes to /project-discovery next.
assertions.evidence_quote: Next gate: once the owner answers, either resume SL-2 on `feat/csv-export` or run `/project-discovery`, then `/requirements-traceability` to resolve R3 vs TICKET-12.

judge.reason: The agent did write docs/agent-ops/INTAKE_RECORD.md, but it didn't route to /project-discovery as the next step. The record lists /project-discovery as just one of two options, and only after the owner answers; the other option is resuming SL-2. The final answer never mentions /project-discovery and stops at questions for the owner. The deviation has a reason (the agent found a likely duplicate), but the routing half of the assertion still doesn't hold.

assertions.text: Finds slice SL-2 'CSV export of invoices' (IN PROGRESS) in projects/demo/BACKLOG.md and marks the request DUPLICATE or EXTENDS with that citation instead of NEW.
assertions.evidence_quote: | D1, D2 | projects/, decisions/, tickets/, src/, test/, README.md (Grep for invoice/billing/csv/export) | **DUPLICATE** | `projects/demo/BACKLOG.md:6`: SL-2 "CSV export of invoices from the billing page", IN PROGRESS on branch `feat/csv-export` |

judge.reason: The agent read projects/demo/BACKLOG.md and found SL-2 listed as IN PROGRESS. In the intake record it marked the request DUPLICATE, not NEW, and cited the backlog line.
